summary.headline: Non-Binary Planetary Conjunctions
summary.text: Hermes the Sage’s judgments for non-binary planetary conjunctions across Aries through Libra, covering prosperity, disease, rebellion, political upheaval, crop blight, earthquakes, eclipses, and weather. Specific combinations of Jupiter, Saturn, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon are interpreted for each sign.
